edges.description: Undernutrition-associated beta-cell impairment and the resulting insulin deficiency are the upstream route to the sustained hyperglycemia that then enters the shared diabetic vascular-complication cascade — the type-5 counterpart of absolute insulin deficiency (type 1) or insulin resistance (type 2) reaching the same chronic-hyperglycemia node.
edges.source: Insulin deficiency from beta-cell impairment in undernutrition
edges.target: Chronic hyperglycemia and vascular complication risk

nodes.description: The marked, sustained hyperglycemia of malnutrition-related (type 5) diabetes is the shared entry point to the conserved diabetic vascular-complication cascade captured by the diabetic_vascular_complications module (chronic hyperglycemia -> oxidative and AGE-RAGE stress -> endothelial dysfunction and vascular inflammation -> micro- and macrovascular injury -> diabetic end-organ complications). Whatever the upstream route to hyperglycemia (here undernutrition-associated beta-cell impairment rather than autoimmunity or insulin resistance), the downstream complication mechanism is shared.
nodes.id: Chronic hyperglycemia and vascular complication risk
